purpose: Time-series trends of MITRE dimensions (technique / attack type / attack stage) over calendar days, derived from validated ML session output without fabrication.

timestamp.behavior: Trend source records require a valid timestamp.

mitre_technique.behavior: Empty source values must not be assigned a fabricated trend value.

attack_type.behavior: Empty source values must not be assigned a fabricated trend value.

attack_stage.behavior: Empty source values must not be assigned a fabricated trend value.

transformation_rules: Read-only with respect to source data.
No modification of production cluster assignments.
No fabrication of MITRE, attack type, or attack stage values.
Only sessions with a valid, non-empty source value contribute to that dimension's trends.
trend_date derives from the session timestamp (UTC date).
